_comment: Editable rules mapping Anthem BCBS document titles to filename summaries. Case-insensitive regexes matched against the title, checked in order: tax, then year-end, then insurance, then statement. An Explanation of Benefits (EOB) is classified as an Insurance Document so it routes to the EOBs folder; the reimbursement EOB Check is told apart in its summary. The 1095-B health-coverage form routes to Tax Documents. Claims summaries and plan/letter documents are not collected yet (separate future collectors); rules for them are left for when those land.
